Subject: 1:1 to discuss recent performance concerns — Fri Apr 10, 2:00 PM (30 min)

Hi Alex,

I’d like to schedule a 30-minute 1:1 to talk about some recent concerns and to hear your perspective. Can you meet Friday, Apr 10 at 2:00 PM? If not, send two times that work this week.

I want to be clear about what I plan to cover so this isn’t a surprise: 
- Missed deadlines: Persona V3 integration was due Mar 15 and shipped Mar 28 (13 days late); the evaluation pipeline due Apr 1 is still not complete.  
- Code review quality: several teammates have raised that reviews have become brief (one-line “LGTM” on complex PRs) instead of substantive feedback.  
- Communication: you missed two standups without notice and have been unresponsive on Teams for 3+ hours on multiple occasions.

I also want to acknowledge that you were a top performer last year — you led the Persona V2 launch, mentored two junior engineers, and earned an “Exceeds” rating. I bring this up because I want to understand if something has changed (capacity, blockers, health, priorities) and how I can support you getting back to that level.

For the meeting, please come prepared to share:
- Any blockers or circumstances affecting these deliveries and reviews  
- What would help you complete the evaluation pipeline and improve review quality (resources, re-prioritization, time)  
- A short proposal for next steps and timelines

This is a conversation to understand and support you, not a disciplinary meeting. I value your work and want to help you get back on track.

Thanks,
[Your Name]
